name: publicWeb_submitKennelRequest
description: hashruns.org/add-kennel (E12.F1.S7): stores a request to add a kennel in EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport as RequestStatus 0 (awaiting email) with a six-digit ConfirmCode; it reaches the review queue only when publicWeb_confirmKennelRequest gets the code back. Guards, in order, before any transaction: required fields and widths (LEN against the column, never a silent cut); the location must exist and agree (region in country, city in region, or free-text city); run fees and membership fields are numbers / a valid type; the three opt-in answers are present; at most five requests per SubmitIp per day. The same email + short name within 30 days with status 0 or 1 is the same request: status 0 gets a fresh code on the existing row, status 1 is reported as already submitted with no code. No device token: reachable only through PublicWebAdminApi behind HC_INTERNAL_SECRET (the Next.js route adds a honeypot, time-to-submit and per-IP limits in front). The API emails the code and removes confirmCode from the reply, adding codeSent. Replaces EXT.ImportNewKennel.

parameters.name: cityText
parameters.description: ≤50, when the city is not listed

parameters.name: hashCash
parameters.description: Run fee for members: required when hasMembership=1 (a number ≥ 0); otherwise ignored and set to the visitors' fee.

parameters.name: nonMemberPrice
parameters.description: Run fee for visitors: required, a number ≥ 0.

parameters.name: hasMembership
parameters.description: '1' or 'true' when the kennel has a membership; then membershipFee, membershipType and hashCash are required. Anything else (or NULL) = no membership: hashCash is set to nonMemberPrice and membershipFee / membershipType are cleared.

parameters.name: membershipType
parameters.typeMismatch: OfficeForms_KennelImport.MembershipRenewalMode is SMALLINT; the parameter is NVARCHAR(MAX), TRY_CAST to SMALLINT and checked IN (1,2,3).

parameters.name: submitIp
parameters.description: set by the Next.js route, cut to 64

parameters.name: terms1
parameters.description: Answer text to opt-in question #1 of the old harriercentral.com form (required, ≤300). Stored as '1: … | 2: … | 3: …'.

parameters.name: terms2
parameters.description: Answer text to opt-in question #2 of the old harriercentral.com form (required, ≤300). Stored as '1: … | 2: … | 3: …'.

parameters.name: terms3
parameters.description: Answer text to opt-in question #3 of the old harriercentral.com form (required, ≤300). Stored as '1: … | 2: … | 3: …'.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always first: { success, errorCode, errorType } in lower case. errorCode 0 / errorType 0 on success; 17xx with errorType 2 on a validation or rate-limit refusal; 1729 with errorType 5 from the CATCH.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Rowset 1 on any refusal. On validation (17xx/2) errorId is a fresh NEWID() that is NOT written to HC.ErrorLog; on the CATCH (1729/5) it is the logged row's id. errorTitle 'Please check the form' / 'Something went wrong'.

rowsets.name: Submitted

columns.name: email
columns.description: The submitted email, trimmed and lower-cased (validated ≤ 250).

columns.name: confirmCode
columns.description: Six digits. NULL when the matching request is already confirmed (status 1). Stripped by the API.

columns.name: alreadySubmitted
columns.description: 1 when an open request for the same email + short name in the last 30 days was found (no new row), else 0.

rowsets.description: Rowset 1 on success. The API sends confirmCode by email, then removes it and adds codeSent (1/0) before replying.

errorCodes.1726: members' fee missing or not a number
errorCodes.1727: visitors' fee missing or not a number
errorCodes.1728: membership fee missing or not a number

sideEffects: INSERT EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport (RequestStatus 0, ConfirmCode, ConfirmAttempts 0, SubmitIp, TermsAnswers '1: … | 2: … | 3: …' cut to 1000, MembershipFee, MembershipRenewalMode, location names cut to 50) for a new request.
UPDATE EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport SET ConfirmCode, ConfirmAttempts = 0, updatedAt for a repeat of an unconfirmed request (existence check under UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK).
INSERT HC.ErrorLog in the CATCH (after ROLLBACK).
PublicWebAdminApi emails the confirmation code (KennelRequestEmails.SendConfirmCodeAsync) and logs 'Kennel request code email not sent' to HC.ErrorLog when a new request's email fails.

codeSmells.issue: errorId returned for a row that does not exist
codeSmells.detail: Validation refusals (lines 165-171) return errorId = NEWID() without an HC.ErrorLog insert. The client holds an id nothing can look up. Refusals are expected user input, so not logging them is reasonable — but the id should then be NULL.

Line 222-223 store LEFT(CountryName, 50) and LEFT(RegionName / CityName, 50) because the EXT columns are narrower than HC.Country/Region/City. The ids are stored alongside, so nothing is lost for the reviewer, but the text columns can be truncated without a word.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
